MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Expansion of Radiotelegraph Service via the United States.
1. Reference is made to memoranda for the Japanese Government as follows:
a. File AG 311.23 (10 Aug 47)CCS, SCAPIN 1759, dated 10 August 1947, subject: Expansion of Radiotelegraph Service via the United States, as amended.
b. File AG 311.22 (29 Sep 47)CCS, SCAPIN 1786, dated 29 September 1947, subject: Provision for Payment for International Messages Filed by Boeki Cho (Japanese Board of Trade).
c. File AG 311.23 (12 Nov 47)CCS, SCAPIN 1818, dated 12 November 1947, subject: Expansion of Radiotelegraph Prepaid Reply (RP) Service, as amended.
2. Effective immediately the Japanese Government is authorized to expand radiotelegraph service via the United States from Japan to the points listed in Inclosure 1. Press messages, originating in Japan destined to Great Britain and/or Australia, may be transmitted optionally prepaid, or on a Transferred Account (T/A) basis, subject to prior agreement between the administrations concerned.
3. All other provisions of SCAPINS 1759 as amended, 1786, and 1818 as amended, pertaining to the acceptance and handling of all classes of radiotelegrams, settlement of accounts and payment of revenue accruing to the participating carriers will apply in this instance.
4. Direct communication between the Civil Communications Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, and the Ministry of Telecommunications, concerning matters within the scope of this memorandum is authorized.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
